description: Source code for ASCII sparklines rendering, including sequence creation, sample addition, and ASCII rendering functions.

methods.name: createSparklineSequence
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new sparkline sequence.

methods.name: sparklineSequenceAddSample
methods.description: Adds a sample with a value and optional label to a sequence.

methods.name: freeSparklineSequence
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a sequence.

methods.name: sparklineRenderRange
methods.description: Renders a portion of a sequence into ASCII sparkline with multiple rows.

methods.name: sparklineRender
methods.description: Converts an entire sequence into its ASCII sparkline representation.
